hunks.baseline: The entrance gaped wide enough for two carriages to pass through side by side, yet not one of the fifty-odd mounted bandits of the Red Wind Band dared set foot inside.
hunks.sol: The entrance gaped wide enough for two carriages to pass through side by side, yet not one of the fifty-odd mounted bandits of the Red Wind Band dared step forward.

hunks.baseline: They had seen clearly how the men who went ahead of them had died.
hunks.sol: They had seen exactly how the men before them had died.

hunks.baseline: Some had died with their heads blown apart. Others had been pierced through the abdomen or killed when their limbs were broken. No one had properly seen when or how Cheol Mubaek’s fist moved.
hunks.sol: Some had died with their heads crushed. Others had been punched through the abdomen or killed with their limbs broken. No one had clearly seen when or how Cheol Mubaek’s fist had moved.

hunks.baseline: More than twenty had died that way.
hunks.sol: More than twenty men had died that way.

hunks.baseline: A deep voice from behind rescued the mounted bandits, who were paralyzed with fear.
hunks.sol: The mounted bandits stood paralyzed with fear until a deep voice came from behind them.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve done enough. Go on now. I’ll handle this place.”
hunks.sol: “You may leave now. I’ll handle this.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t recall ever taking a bandit as a junior.”

hunks.sol: “You’re still as prickly as ever. They say even brushing sleeves creates a bond, and you and I have traded blows, haven’t we?”

hunks.baseline: “We did. Then you ran away without even looking back.”
hunks.sol: “We have. Then you ran away without looking back.”

hunks.baseline: “Let’s call it a strategic retreat. I didn’t expect Senior Cheol to show up there, either.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s call it a strategic retreat. I didn’t expect you to show up there either, Senior Cheol.”

hunks.baseline: “Are your internal injuries healed?”
hunks.sol: “Have your internal injuries healed?”

hunks.baseline: “My insides were burning, so I had a rough few days. But it wasn’t enough to kill me, which is why I’ve come back despite my shame.”
hunks.sol: “My insides burned for several days, so I had a rough time of it. But it wasn’t enough to kill me, which is why I’ve shamelessly returned.”

hunks.baseline: “Today, it won’t end with mere heat.”
hunks.sol: “Today, it won’t end with a little heat.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, dear. How about we settle this through conversation? For a man of your age to have such a fiery temper…”
hunks.sol: “Oh, dear. Why don’t we settle this with words? A man of your age shouldn’t have such a fiery temper…”

hunks.baseline: At Pung Yang’s shameless remark, Cheol Mubaek ground his teeth.
hunks.sol: Cheol Mubaek ground his teeth at Pung Yang’s glib response.

hunks.baseline: “Conversation? If you hadn’t betrayed us, Lee Cheonbaek, my friend, might have lived.”
hunks.sol: “Words? If you hadn’t betrayed us, my friend Cheonbaek might still be alive.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m not stupid enough to join a fight with no chance of winning.”
hunks.sol: “I’m not stupid enough to join a fight with no chance of victory.”

hunks.baseline: “As if that weren’t enough, you killed Lee Seogwang too?”
hunks.sol: “And that wasn’t enough for you? You had to kill Seogwang too?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m not softhearted enough to spare a brat who came at me without knowing his place.”
hunks.sol: “I’m not softhearted enough to spare a brat who attacked me without knowing his place.”

hunks.baseline: “If I’d known that brat would become my brother-in-law, I might have spared him.”
hunks.sol: “If I’d known the brat would become my brother-in-law, I might have spared him.”

hunks.baseline: A lava-like aura boiled up from every inch of Cheol Mubaek’s body. Under the formidable Scorching Yang Qi of a Peak master, the snow blanketing the ground melted away, and the vegetation turned yellow.
hunks.sol: An aura like molten lava boiled from Cheol Mubaek’s entire body. Before the formidable Scorching Yang Qi of a Peak master, the snow covering the ground melted and the vegetation yellowed.

hunks.baseline: Pung Yang let out an exclamation at the sight.
hunks.sol: Pung Yang exclaimed in admiration at the sight.

hunks.baseline: “Your internal energy really is remarkable. If Senior Cheol had only set his mind to it, the opponent I faced today would have been the Mount Heng Fist Sect.”
hunks.sol: “Your internal energy is remarkable, as expected. If you’d put your mind to it, Senior Cheol, I suppose I’d be facing the Mount Heng Fist Sect today.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll tear your limbs from your body.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll rip off your limbs.”

hunks.baseline: “Still, you shouldn’t be too confident.”
hunks.sol: “I wouldn’t be so confident.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t expect the same stroke of luck as last time. Today, you won’t have anyone to use as a shield.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t count on the same stroke of luck as last time. You have no one to use as a shield today.”

hunks.baseline: Cheol Mubaek hesitated. Pung Yang’s relaxed attitude had been bothering him for some time.
hunks.sol: Cheol Mubaek hesitated. Pung Yang’s relaxed demeanor had been bothering him for some time.

hunks.baseline: Last time, Pung Yang had withdrawn after suffering internal injuries in barely a hundred exchanges. The fact that the man who had used his subordinates as shields to escape had sent everyone away and come here of his own accord meant that he was confident enough to do so…
hunks.sol: Last time, Pung Yang had retreated with internal injuries after barely a hundred exchanges. The man had used his subordinates as shields while he fled, yet now he had dismissed everyone and come forward alone.
That could only mean he was confident.

hunks.baseline: “What kind of dirty trick are you planning?”
hunks.sol: “What dirty trick are you planning?”

hunks.baseline: “A dirty trick? I simply couldn’t use a chicken-killing knife on a tiger, so I stepped in myself.”
hunks.sol: “A dirty trick? I merely stepped forward because one doesn’t use a knife meant for chickens to kill a tiger.”

hunks.baseline: “Is there any reason I can’t?”
hunks.sol: “Why not?”

hunks.baseline: “There’s no way. I’m grateful, if anything.”
hunks.sol: “No reason. I’m grateful, if anything.”

hunks.baseline: “Thanks to you, this will be over easily.”
hunks.sol: “Thanks to you, this will be over quickly.”

hunks.baseline: The instant he finished speaking, a scorching gale rushed straight toward Pung Yang. Pung Yang swallowed a breath and swung his curved saber at the red fist energy flying toward his chest.
hunks.sol: The instant he finished speaking, a scorching gale hurtled forward. Pung Yang caught his breath and swung his curved saber at the red fist energy flying toward his chest.

hunks.baseline: The two Peak masters collided. Roaring explosions rang out one after another, and the resulting wind swept across the snow-covered ground.
hunks.sol: The two Peak masters collided. Thunderous explosions rang out one after another, and the resulting gusts swept across the snow-covered ground.

hunks.baseline: Beneath a mound of snow that had leaped high into the air, one man staggered backward.
hunks.sol: Beneath the plume of snow thrown high into the air, one man staggered backward.

hunks.baseline: Pung Yang swallowed a groan and looked at his torn palm. He had avoided the disgrace of dropping his weapon, but the difference in strength was undeniable.
hunks.sol: Pung Yang swallowed a groan and looked down at his torn palm. He had avoided the humiliation of dropping his weapon, but the difference in strength was undeniable.

hunks.baseline: “You’re still as strong as ever.”
hunks.sol: “You’re every bit as strong as I expected.”

hunks.baseline: Cheol Mubaek stepped toward him and answered.
hunks.sol: Cheol Mubaek advanced toward him.

hunks.baseline: “You’ll regret this, but it’s already too late.”
hunks.sol: “It’s too late for regrets.”

hunks.baseline: “I feel the same way.”
hunks.sol: “My thoughts exactly.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll have to tear that mouth of yours apart first.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll start by tearing that mouth apart.”

hunks.baseline: Cheol Mubaek lunged forward with the movements of a tiger.
hunks.sol: Cheol Mubaek lunged like a tiger.

hunks.baseline: The fierce forms of the long-lost Shura Annihilating Fist poured down upon Pung Yang.
hunks.sol: The ferocious forms of the Shura Annihilating Fist, a martial art thought to have been lost long ago, poured down upon Pung Yang.

hunks.baseline: Kwa-gwa-gwang!
hunks.sol: Kwararabang!

hunks.baseline: A fierce bloody battle was raging along the fortress walls. Despite facing a four-to-one disadvantage in numbers, the martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect refused to retreat.
hunks.sol: A fierce battle raged atop the fortress walls. Despite being outnumbered four to one, the martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect refused to retreat.

hunks.baseline: “Are you going to let those mounted-bandit bastards take our home from us?”
hunks.sol: “Are you going to let those mounted-bandit bastards steal our home?”

hunks.baseline: “Let’s avenge the martial brothers they killed!”
hunks.sol: “Avenge the martial brothers they killed!”

hunks.baseline: Slice! Thrust!
hunks.sol: Slash! Thrust!

hunks.baseline: “D-don’t push me!”
hunks.sol: “D-don’t push!”

hunks.sol: The mounted bandits of the Red Wind Band were in disarray. The earlier fire attack had shaken them, and the fear of another trap held them back.

hunks.baseline: In stark contrast, the martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect charged at them wild-eyed. The mounted bandits were helpless against their unstoppable momentum and were cut down one after another.
hunks.sol: The martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect, meanwhile, charged with bloodshot eyes. Before their unstoppable onslaught, the mounted bandits were helplessly cut down one after another.

hunks.sol: The mounted-bandit captains shouted themselves hoarse, but it wasn’t enough to restore order. Instead, they too gave up their lives to arrows that came from nowhere.

hunks.sol: Lee Seowol stood atop the highest watchtower, loosing arrow after arrow.

hunks.sol: Beside her were the five finest archers among the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s martial artists.

hunks.sol: Every time a bowstring sang, a mounted bandit fell. Captains and those who appeared to hold even higher positions were their first targets.

hunks.baseline: *One more. One more.*
hunks.sol: *One more. Just one more.*

hunks.baseline: But the battle was unfolding more harshly than expected.
hunks.sol: But the battle was going worse than expected.

hunks.baseline: The martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect had entered the battle with fewer troops from the very beginning. They grew exhausted at an alarming rate, and before long, one or two at a time began losing their lives to stray blades.
hunks.sol: The Mount Heng Sword Sect had begun the battle with too few fighters. Its martial artists tired quickly, and before long, they began falling one by one to stray blades.

hunks.baseline: “Get a grip! There aren’t many of these Mount Heng Sword Sect bastards!”
hunks.sol: “Get ahold of yourselves! There are barely any of these Mount Heng Sword Sect bastards!”

hunks.baseline: “If we kill these men, victory is ours!”
hunks.sol: “Kill them, and victory is ours!”

hunks.baseline: The martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect had nothing left to lose. They fought desperately, disregarding their disadvantage.
hunks.sol: The martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect had nothing left to lose. They fought desperately, heedless of the odds against them.

hunks.baseline: Slice! Slice! Slice!
hunks.sol: Slash! Slash! Slash!

hunks.baseline: But every time one mounted bandit was cut down, two more appeared to fill the gap. When two were cut down, three took their place.
hunks.sol: But whenever they cut down one mounted bandit, two more filled the gap. Whenever they cut down two, three took their place.

hunks.sol: Neck, chest, abdomen… All across the wall, martial artists were hacked and pierced from head to toe, dying before they could even scream.

hunks.sol: Their momentum rising, the mounted bandits of the Red Wind Band pressed their attack without pause. Before long, enemies crowded half the fortress wall.

hunks.baseline: Lee Seowol summoned every last bit of strength she had and drew her bowstring. Blood ran from her once-delicate fingers and between her clenched teeth, while the dry inside of her mouth reeked of a sickly sweetness.
hunks.sol: Lee Seowol drew on every last ounce of strength to pull her bowstring. Blood ran from her once-delicate fingers and seeped between her clenched teeth. Her parched mouth tasted sickly sweet.

hunks.baseline: “There!”
hunks.sol: “There she is!”

hunks.baseline: After firing arrows without rest, her position was discovered before long. When about twenty mounted bandits raised their shields and charged toward the watchtower, desperate shouts rang out.
hunks.sol: After her relentless barrage of arrows, it wasn’t long before they discovered her position. Some twenty mounted bandits raised their shields and charged toward the watchtower, prompting desperate shouts.

hunks.baseline: “You have to get away! They’re coming!”
hunks.sol: “You must get away! They’re coming!”

hunks.baseline: Three shichen—six hours—had passed since the siege began. Lee Seowol had only practiced archery as a hobby. She was not a martial artist, and her Stamina had reached its limit long ago.
hunks.sol: Three shichen had passed since the siege began. Lee Seowol had only practiced archery as a hobby. She was no martial artist, and her Stamina had reached its limit long ago.

hunks.baseline: But she did not stop. She forced strength into her thin, trembling arms and searched for her next target.
hunks.sol: Yet she did not stop. She forced strength into her slender, trembling arms and searched for another target.

hunks.baseline: *Escape? Where would I go?*
hunks.sol: *Get away? Where would I go?*

hunks.baseline: She had lived here her entire life. To Lee Seowol, the Mount Heng Sword Sect was both her hometown and something she had to protect until the final moment of her life.
hunks.sol: She had lived here all her life. To Lee Seowol, the Mount Heng Sword Sect was both her home and something she had to protect until her final breath.

hunks.baseline: The same was true for the martial artists who continued their last stand.
hunks.sol: The same was true of the martial artists still making their last stand.

hunks.baseline: “Never let them reach the Sect Leader!”
hunks.sol: “Don’t let them reach the Sect Leader!”

hunks.baseline: Their desperate cries were futile. The fortress walls had already been overrun.
hunks.sol: Their desperate cries were in vain. The fortress walls had already been overrun.

hunks.baseline: The surviving martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect retreated to the watchtower. But more than a hundred mounted bandits were closing in from every direction.
hunks.sol: The surviving martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect retreated toward the watchtower, but well over a hundred mounted bandits were closing in from every direction.

hunks.baseline: Eyes gleaming with killing intent and desire shone between the torches held by the advancing enemies.
hunks.sol: Between the torches in their hands gleamed eyes filled with killing intent and desire.

hunks.baseline: “You damned bastards dare…”
hunks.sol: “How dare these damned bastards…”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll tear every last one of you limb from limb and throw you to the dogs!”
hunks.sol: “I’ll tear every last one of you apart and throw the pieces to the dogs.”

hunks.baseline: The killing intent of the mounted bandits surrounding the watchtower in a circle stabbed at their skin.
hunks.sol: The killing intent of the mounted bandits encircling the watchtower prickled against their skin.

hunks.baseline: Just as everyone was falling into despair, Lee Seowol suddenly drew her bowstring toward the sky.
hunks.sol: Just as everyone sank into despair, Lee Seowol suddenly aimed her bow at the sky.

hunks.baseline: Trailing a tail of fire, a single fire arrow descended toward the gate, which was shrouded in darkness.
hunks.sol: Trailing a tail of flame, a single fire arrow descended toward the gate shrouded in darkness.

hunks.baseline: “I suppose it’s a little late to say this now…”
hunks.sol: “I suppose it’s rather late to say this…”

hunks.sol: Unable to bring herself to look, she closed her eyes.

hunks.sol: Pung Yang beamed at her.

hunks.baseline: The hunter Cheol Mubaek became the Tiger of Mount Heng because of a fortuitous encounter.
hunks.sol: The hunter Cheol Mubaek had become the Tiger of Mount Heng because of a fortuitous encounter.

hunks.baseline: While tracking wolves along a mountainside in the vast Mount Heng range, he fell between cliffs into a hidden cave. There, he discovered a martial arts manual and an elixir left behind by a reclusive master.
hunks.sol: While tracking a wolf on a mountainside in the vast Mount Heng range, he fell into a hidden cave between the cliffs. There, he discovered a martial arts manual and an elixir left behind by a reclusive master.

hunks.baseline: *I’m going back. I’m going back alive, no matter what!*
hunks.sol: *I’m going back. I’ll make it back alive, no matter what!*

hunks.baseline: Cheol Mubaek learned martial arts to survive. When the fasting pills in the hidden cave ran out, he tore up grass growing between the cliffs or caught bats to eat as he trained.
hunks.sol: Cheol Mubaek learned martial arts to survive. When the fasting pills in the hidden cave ran out, he pulled up grass growing between the cliffs and caught bats to eat as he trained.

hunks.baseline: After no less than three years, he climbed the cliff with his bare hands and returned to the village.
hunks.sol: After three long years, he climbed the cliff with his bare hands and returned to his village.

hunks.baseline: What awaited him was his home in ruins—and the deaths of his wife and child.
hunks.sol: What awaited him was his home in ruins and his wife and child dead.

hunks.baseline: *Had it been a couple of months since we lost contact? That bastard Hwang, who’d always had his eye on your wife…*
hunks.sol: *Had it been two months or so since we last heard from you? That bastard Hwang, who’d always had his eye on your wife…*

hunks.baseline: By the time he came to his senses, he had already beaten the village’s leading landowner and all his servants to death.
hunks.sol: By the time Cheol Mubaek came to his senses, he had already beaten the village’s great landowner and all his servants to death.

hunks.baseline: After avenging his family, Cheol Mubaek returned to the hidden cave and resumed his martial arts training. It was a whip he used against himself, and atonement for his family.

hunks.sol: Cheol Mubaek breathed raggedly. His once-brilliant eyes were clouded as if by storm clouds, and his beard was drenched in blood.

hunks.baseline: *I have to hurry. I have to stop that bastard…*
hunks.sol: *I have to hurry. I have to stop him…*

hunks.sol: But willpower was all he had left. With all four limbs broken, his body was already beyond his control. He had unleashed martial arts worthy of the name Tiger of Mount Heng, yet he had still failed to defeat Pung Yang.

hunks.baseline: *How in the world did he…?*
hunks.sol: *How did that bastard…?*

hunks.sol: The outcome should have been obvious. Pung Yang had only just entered the Peak realm and could barely produce blade qi, while Cheol Mubaek was a seasoned Peak master.

hunks.sol: Pung Yang had been flickering like a candle in the wind—until he pulled an unidentified wooden case from inside his robes.

hunks.baseline: *The red pill. Yes, that was definitely it.*
hunks.sol: *That red pill. Yes, that was definitely it.*

hunks.sol: Mistaking it for a hidden weapon, Cheol Mubaek had backed away. That had been his mistake. The moment Pung Yang swallowed the pill, he ceased to be the mere leader of a mounted-bandit group Cheol Mubaek had known.

hunks.baseline: *How can a human being become that strong?*
hunks.sol: *How can any human become that strong?*

hunks.sol: The gap between them had been so vast that he could not imagine winning even if they fought ten or a hundred more times. Pung Yang had overturned the battle in an instant, broken all four of his limbs, inflicted grievous internal injuries, and left.
